mapper.select: SELECT aglfd.id, dc.channel_id, dc.channel_name, ddpgl.user_type, ddpgl.dates, ddpgl.pkg, ddpgl.game_level, ddpgl.user_num, ddpgl.record_count, ddpgl.avg_record_count, ddpgl.pass_user_num, ddpgl.pass_rate, ddpgl.fail_user_num, ddpgl.fail_rate, ddpgl.fail_record_count, ddpgl.fail_record_rate FROM dws_daily_package_game_level ddpgl LEFT JOIN dim_channel dc ON (dc.pkg = ddpgl.pkg) LEFT JOIN ads_game_level_full_daily aglfd ON (aglfd.dates = ddpgl.dates and aglfd.pkg = ddpgl.pkg and aglfd.user_type = ddpgl.user_type and aglfd.game_level = ddpgl.game_level) WHERE ddpgl.dates = #{dates}
